summary: postinstall fetches and executes a binary from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint with TLS verification disabled
details: On npm install, postinstall.mjs runs ensurePlatformBinary → downloadAndExtractPlatformPackage, which fetches a platform tarball over HTTPS from a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint (https://218.90.133.98:4443/onecode_tgz/onecode-<ver>/onecode-linux-x64-<ver>.tgz) with rejectUnauthorized:false, follows redirects while preserving that TLS bypass, extracts the tarball with tar -xzf, chmods the extracted binary 0755, and hardlinks it as bin/.onecode used by the onecode CLI. There is no hash or signature verification of the downloaded bytes. The publisher scope is @onescience but the delivery host is an unrelated bare IPv4 address rather than a publisher-owned domain, and TLS verification is explicitly disabled, so any on-path attacker or the IP's operator can substitute arbitrary bytes that will then be executed on the installer's machine whenever the CLI is invoked.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
